datasets.name: f8b5b91a
queryLines:
SELECT lesson_id, n, step_label,
  CASE mistake_kind WHEN 'live' THEN 'Live' ELSE mistake_kind END AS mistake_kind,
  mistakes, avg_confidence
FROM workspace.handover.ds_mistakes_real

datasets.name: 9b10d798
queryLines:
SELECT
  e.lesson_id,
  e.run_id,
  date_format(from_utc_timestamp(r.started_at, 'America/Chicago'), 'MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS run_started,
  CASE e.reason WHEN 'camera' THEN 'Camera' WHEN 'voice' THEN 'Voice' ELSE 'Button' END AS method,
  1 AS steps,
  CASE WHEN e.reason = 'camera' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS camera_pct
FROM workspace.handover.events_real e
JOIN workspace.handover.runs_real r ON r.run_id = e.run_id
WHERE e.kind = 'advance' AND e.to_step > e.from_step

datasets.name: e35c9207
queryLines:
SELECT
  lesson_id,
  run_id,
  round(latency_ms / 1000.0, 3) AS latency_s
FROM workspace.handover.events_real
WHERE kind = 'check' AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND coalesce(get_json_object(extra, '$.model'), '') <> 'mock'
  AND get_json_object(extra, '$.error_kind') IS NULL

lines: Each bar group is one step of the lesson: how long learners took (median, dark grey) next to the expert's own time in the take (light grey). Live camera runs only: replays, mock checks and self-tests are left out.
Pick the lesson. **Green** = the camera confirmed the step. **Grey** = the learner pressed Next. **Amber** = a mistake the camera caught. Times in Madison time (CST).

frame.title: Finished
frame.description: Runs that reached the last step

frame.title: Camera-checked %
frame.description: Steps the camera confirmed; manual steps always use Next

frame.title: Check p50 (s)
frame.description: Median camera check, answered checks only

frame.title: Time per step: learners vs the expert
frame.description: Where the dark bar is far longer than the light one, people get stuck. Learner bars appear once live runs are logged.

frame.title: How each step was passed
frame.description: Green = the camera saw the step done. Grey = the learner pressed Next or said it.

frame.title: Mistakes the camera caught, per step
frame.description: Behind = still looks like the previous step. Ahead = already on the next one. Live = a known mistake spotted mid-fold (advisory).

frame.title: Step by step
frame.description: x expert = learner median / expert time. False pass = camera pass undone with Back within 60 s.

frame.title: Steps per run
frame.description: One bar per run, split by how each step was passed.

lines: # How well does the camera check work?
What the check answered on each step, how long it took, where learners overrode it with Next, and where it let someone through too early.
Latency counts answered checks only: timeouts and errors are left out. **Green** = check said yes.

frame.title: Check answers per step
frame.description: Yes = step done. Unsure never counts as done.

frame.title: Manual-advance rate (camera steps)
frame.description: Share of advances on camera steps forced with Next instead of a camera pass.

frame.title: False passes
frame.description: Camera passes the learner undid with Back within 60 s. A lower bound.

frame.title: Checks off incidents
frame.description: The breaker opened; learners used Next until it closed.
